h1: Export and share reports in a few clicks
overview: People often need to take a number out of the dashboard and put it in an email, a spreadsheet or a meeting. We add export buttons that produce clean CSV and PDF files with the filters the user chose, and shareable links that open a read-only view of a report. Links can expire and be switched off at any time, so private data stays private.

faq: Will exports handle large data sets?
Yes. Big exports are built in the background and offered as a download when ready, so the screen does not freeze. We test with a realistic number of rows.
Is it safe to share a report by link?
Links are random, read-only and can expire or be revoked. You can also add a password. We still advise sharing only what you are happy for the link holder to see.
Can the PDF match my brand?
Yes. We add your logo, colors and a title, and make sure tables break across pages sensibly. Send your brand files or a link to your site.
Does it work with my existing charts and tables?
Yes. We read the filters already on screen and export the same view. If your charts use an uncommon library, we tell you before starting if the PDF needs a different approach.
